day_local: Sabtida Toddobaadkii Laba iyo Tobnaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
homily:
Waxaa jira saacado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan marka qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuusta ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arkeysaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay xadhigga kabaha oo si qaldan u yaalla, ama buug uu Ben dhigay miiska, ama xataa sawirka diyaarad uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa oo weli derbiga sudhan. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'dharka lagu xirto Masiixa'. Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Waayo, kulli idinka oo Masiixa lagu baabtiisay, waxaad huwateen Masiixa.' Bal ka feker sawirkaas. Ma aha dhar caadi ah oo aan xiranno subaxdii. Waa dhar ka samaysan jacayl, naxariis, iyo iimaan. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba 'huwanaa' jacaylkaas. Xusuusnow sida uu u dhisayey barnaamijyadiisa kombuyuutarka, sida uu ugu qorayey koodhka GitHub, ama sida uu ugu taabtay nolosha dadka kale jacayl aan xad lahayn. Ben wuxuu lahaa qalbi u taagnaa abuuridda, dhisidda, iyo jacaylka. Wuxuu xirtay Masiixa markii uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu doonayo inuu bixiyo dhammaan lacagta piggy bank-giisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in lagu dhex noolaado Masiixa.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay ahaayeen kuwo adag. Waxaa jira waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in xanuunka uu ka weyn yahay iftiinka. Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Waxaad siiseen Ben jacayl aan xad lahayn, waalidnimadiinuna waxay ahayd hadiyad uu Ben ku koray. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, markii haweeneydu ay ku qaylisay, 'Barakaysan yahay uurkii ku sidday,' Ciise wuxuu u jawaabay: 'Halkii, waxaa barakaysan kuwa maqla ereyga Ilaah oo xajiya.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil maqlay ereyga Ilaah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aaminsan in 'isku daygu uu yahay waxa kaliya ee muhiimka ah'. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in jacaylka Masiixa uu weli idin daboolayo, iyagoo idin xusuusinaya in jacaylku uu weligiis noolaan doono. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda ku siiyo. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin Eucharist-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana naftayda kuu dhiibayaa gebi ahaanba. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna qaaliga ah ee Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee xagga Rabbiga aaday, ha ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiixa.
Qoysaska ay hayso murugada iyo cidladu, gaar ahaan reer Alan iyo Thao, Ilaah ha siiyo raaxada Ruuxa Quduuska ah iyo rajada dhimanayn.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaalow: Qorniinku wuxuu wax walba hoos geliyey dembiga, si ballanka loogu siiyo kuwa rumaystay iimaanka Ciise Masiix. Intaan iimaanku iman, waxaa laynagu hayay sharciga hoostiisa, innagoo loo hayay iimaanka la muujin doono. Sidaas daraaddeed, sharcigu wuxuu ahaa kormeerahayagii Masiixa, si laynoogu xaqdhowro iimaanka. Laakiin hadda oo iimaankii yimid, mar dambe ma nihin kuwa sharciga hoostiisa jira. Waayo, kulli idinka oo Masiixa lagu baabtiisay, waxaad huwateen Masiixa. Ma jiro Yuhuudi iyo Gariig toona, ma jiro addoon iyo qof xor ah toona, ma jiro lab iyo dheddig toona, waayo kulli waxaad tihiin mid xagga Ciise Masiix. Haddii aad tihiin kuwa Masiixa, markaas waxaad tihiin farcankii Ibraahim, oo ah kuwa dhaxla ballanka.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbigu wuxuu xusuustaa axdigiisa weligiis. U heesa isaga, u heesa ammaan, ku dhawaaqa shuqulladiisa cajiibka ah. Ku faana magaciisa quduuska ah; ha rayraystaan qalbiyada Rabbiga doondoonaya! Rabbigu wuxuu xusuustaa axdigiisa weligiis. Rabbiga u jeesta xaggiisa, doondoona inaad mar walba u adeegtaan. Xusuusta shuqullada yaabka leh ee uu sameeyey, calaamadaha iyo xukunnada uu ku dhawaaqay. Rabbigu wuxuu xusuustaa axdigiisa weligiis. Idinka farcankii Ibraahim, addoomadiisa, carruurtii Yacquub, kuwa uu doortay! Isagu, Rabbiga, waa Ilaaheenna; dunida oo dhan xukunnadiisu way ka taliyaan. Rabbigu wuxuu xusuustaa axdigiisa weligiis.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Iyadoo Ciise hadlayay, haweeney dadkii ku jirtay ayaa kor u qaylisay oo ku tiri: 'Barakaysan yahay uurkii ku sidday iyo naasahaagii aad nuugtay.' Isaguna wuxuu ugu jawaabay: 'Halkii, waxaa barakaysan kuwa maqla ereyga Ilaah oo xajiya.'

day: Saturday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
